summary: Bluerock Acquisition Corp. II, a Cayman-domiciled blank-check company, closed a $172.5M IPO of 17.25M units at $10.00, including the full 2.25M-unit over-allotment, so each unit holds one Class A share and one-half warrant exercisable at $11.50 beginning 30 days after an initial business combination. The 8-K also reports related underwriting and warrant agreements plus officer and bylaw items. BTIG acted as representative of the underwriters. With no target named and a 24-month deal clock, risk-arb focus is trust accretion and redemption terms.
